title: Coherent higher direct images under a proper morphism of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism with $Y$ locally Noetherian. Proper means separated (the diagonal is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]), quasi-compact and locally of finite type on etale scheme charts [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and universally closed on underlying spaces after every algebraic-space base change. Work with module sheaves on the small etale ringed sites [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Locally Noetherian means that etale scheme charts are locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Coherent means that on every affine etale chart $\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $R$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], the module sheaf is associated to a finitely generated $R$-module $N$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], with value $B\otimes_RN$ on affine etale maps $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$. For a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, let $R^if_*F$ be the $i$-th cohomology of $f_*I^\bullet$, where $F\to I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution in module sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and $f_*$ is module direct image under the induced ringed-topos morphism [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Then $R^if_*F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module for every integer $i\geq0$.

proof.text: In compatible etale scheme charts $U\to V$ over $X\to Y$, $V$ is locally Noetherian and $U\to V$ is locally of finite type; [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] makes $U$ locally Noetherian. This is exactly local Noetherianity of $X$. Restrict to affine Noetherian etale charts of $Y$. The fibre products exist by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], properness persists by [lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change], and [lem-sfb-space-higher-image-etale-restriction] identifies every restricted higher image with that of the restricted coherent module. Coherence is chartwise in the statement, so it suffices to prove the assertion for $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $A$ Noetherian. Now $X$ is quasi-compact by properness and quasi-separated: its diagonal over the affine base is closed, hence quasi-compact since a closed immersion is affine on scheme tests by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc]. Thus $X$ is Noetherian (locally Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated).

source.place: Tag 08AR, first two paragraphs; Tag 04ZK chart argument. The fp detour is unnecessary for the three defining conditions of Noetherianity.

proof.text: For coherent $M$ on $X$, let $\mathcal P(M)$ mean that $R^pf_*M$ is coherent for every $p\geq0$. It holds for zero and is invariant under isomorphisms. The module categories are Grothendieck with enough injectives by [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] and [lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives]. Module direct image is additive and left exact (it is the right adjoint of module tensor pullback). Therefore [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-long-exact] gives the long exact higher-image sequence of any coherent short exact sequence. Every term is quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-higher-direct-image-quasi-coherent]. Kernels and images between these terms are quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits]. If two source terms have $\mathcal P$, each higher image of the third is an extension of a quotient of a coherent term by a quasi-coherent submodule of another coherent term. These subquotients are coherent by [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support], and their extension is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian]. At degree zero the sequence starts with zero. Thus $\mathcal P$ satisfies two-out-of-three.

The functors $R^pf_*$ preserve finite direct sums: take the finite direct sum of injective resolutions, whose terms are injective because extension into a finite sum is extension into each coordinate, and use additivity of $f_*$ and of cohomology. If $R^pf_*(M^{\oplus r})$ is coherent for $r\geq1$, its summand $R^pf_*M$ is the kernel of an idempotent endomorphism of this coherent module, hence coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian]. Consequently $\mathcal P(M^{\oplus r})$ implies $\mathcal P(M)$.

Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a reduced closed subspace with nonempty irreducible point space. The map $g=f\circ i$ is proper by [lem-sfb-space-closed-subspace-proper] and [lem-sfb-space-proper-composition]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-chow-acyclic-full-support-witness] to $g$. It supplies an actual projective Chow twist $G=\pi_*L^{\otimes d}$ on $Z$, coherent with zero annihilator and full support, with $g_*G$ coherent and $R^pg_*G=0$ for $p>0$. This is one selected module on $Z$, not an appeal to coherence of all proper higher images.

source.place: Tag 08AR, verification of condition (3), Chow and twisting paragraphs.

proof.text: Put $M=i_*G$. It is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules]. On every scheme test, $i$ is a closed immersion and hence affine by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc]; thus $i$ is an affine space morphism. By [lem-sfb-space-affine-module-higher-image-vanishing], $R^qi_*G=0$ for $q>0$. Apply [lem-sfb-ringed-topos-relative-leray] to $i,f,G$: only row $q=0$ survives, so its finite abutment filtration has exactly one possible nonzero graded piece, giving $R^pf_*i_*G\cong R^pg_*G$ for every $p\geq0$. The preceding step implies $\mathcal P(M)$. Finally, let $J=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$. The quotient and essential-image assertions of [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules] identify the action on $M$ with the action through $\mathcal O_X/J$. Since $G$ has zero annihilator, a local function annihilates $M$ exactly when its image in $\mathcal O_Z$ is zero, checked on the same etale charts. Hence $\operatorname{Ann}(M)=J$: its scheme theoretic support is exactly $Z$.

source.place: Tag 08AR, initial paragraph of condition (3); Tag 0734 (relative Leray); Tag 08AM (closed module equivalence).

proof.text: Steps 2 and 3 verify the zero, isomorphism, two-out-of-three and finite-sum-reflection hypotheses of [lem-sfb-space-coherent-two-of-three-devissage]. Steps 4 and 5 supply its required module for every integral reduced closed subspace. Apply that lemma to the Noetherian space $X$ of Step 1. It gives $\mathcal P(F)$ for every coherent $F$, including on the empty space because $\mathcal P(0)$ was verified. Step 1 then descends coherence from the affine etale charts to the original $Y$, proving every asserted degree.

Step 1 reduces to an affine Noetherian base: 01T6 on charts, étale restriction of module R^q f_*, and quasi-separatedness from the closed diagonal over Spec A. Step 2 is two-out-of-three via the long exact sequence, quasi-coherence of higher images, coherent subquotients and coherent extensions. Step 3 (summands as idempotent kernels) is rightly elementary. Steps 4-5 give g proper, take the witness G, show R^q i_*G=0 with the module 073H node, use the new module relative Leray (row-0 collapse) to get R^p f_* i_*G ≅ R^p g_*G, and prove Ann(i_*G)=J through the closed-immersion essential image and Ann(G)=0.
